description: Missouri-focused construction-opportunity intelligence platform for contractors and estimators.
notes: Howell Opportunity Radar is a Missouri-focused construction-opportunity intelligence platform for contractors, estimators, and preconstruction teams. It organizes public-project signals from state agencies, municipalities, universities, utilities, and other public sources by project stage, geography, trade fit, deadlines, and freshness, while linking users back to official sources for verification. It is a discovery and pursuit-intelligence layer, not a replacement for official solicitation documents, planrooms, estimating, takeoff, or project-management software.
